fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-04-29 states that an online seller collected an advance of Rs. 3,500 for a product and then blocked the number of the complainant, on 2025-04-27 at about 00:05. Contact details given by the complainant, Durga Bai, include the number 9000000388. Ramesh Pandian (9000000469) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Transactions from the account SYN-ACC-100063, held by the complainant, were referred to in the complaint. Kishore Babu (mobile 9000000076) was named as a possible person of interest.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Seller allegedly collected an advance through an online advertisement and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: online shopping fraud, fake seller, main street, suspect, mobile number, night, witness, phone records
